title: Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice
abstract: arXiv:2608.30873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. translated_title: 角色设定不同于母语生成：语言路径塑造大语言模型的人际建议
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于提供人际建议，并作为研究跨语言、跨文化社会行为的工具。引出语言或文化相关差异的一个常见捷径，是要求模型以母语者的身份作答。我们测试了这种“母语者角色设定”是否能够复现模型直接用目标语言生成建议、再将回答翻译回英文时所得到的输出。我们使用涵盖13种语言、8个大语言模型的600个人际建议问题，比较了“母语生成后翻译”（NL）与“母语者角色提示”（NP）两种方式，测量了语言风格、行为支架以及强制选择的行为建议。我们发现NP与NL并不可互换。与NL相比，NP往往会增加词汇层面的社交线索（如亲和性和积极语气），同时降低具体性和社会协调性等特质；NP提供的行为建议也更少……
tldr: 研究表明，让大语言模型扮演母语者的角色提示与让其直接用目标语言生成建议再翻译回英文的结果不可互换，二者在语言风格、社交线索和行为建议上存在系统性差异，说明语言路径本身塑造了模型的人际建议输出。
en_tdlr: Native-speaker persona prompting is not interchangeable with native-language generation followed by translation: across 13 languages and eight LLMs, language pathways systematically shape the linguistic style and action recommendations in LLM interpersonal advice.
